title: Figures 21-22: CFD temperature and Mach number contours around cylinder UAP model
description: Two CFD contour plots for a cylinder-shaped UAP model at 1/6 scale, 223K air temperature and 700 mph with mixed inlet and supersonic outlet. Figure 21 maps temperature in Kelvin showing a hot wake; Figure 22 maps Mach number distribution around the blunt cylinder. Part of the BAASS aerodynamic analysis comparing UAP shapes.
